title: Can Pueblo police track your car? What the city's ALPR policy says
summary: Pueblo Police Chief Chris Noeller presented the department's ALPR policy to City Council amid ongoing debate, outlining authorized uses (locating stolen vehicles, missing persons, investigations) and prohibitions (personal use, immigration enforcement, monitoring protected groups). The article notes Pueblo has 93 ALPR systems per FindingFlock.com data.

key_quotes.quote: They assist in real-time crime detection, locating stolen vehicles, fugitives and missing persons
Generalized, speculative, open-ended searches of an individual's travel, vehicle association and patterns are prohibited unless there is a documented public safety or criminal purpose.
